title: 5 Maji residents’ reported first protest amid home demolitions
scope: Local action; possible start of a wider residents’ campaign, with episode boundaries unresolved.
organizer: Residents affected by the 5 Maji demolition plan; no formal organizer identified.
threshold_50_evidence: Not established. A Feb. 6 follow-up calls Jan. 19 the campaign’s first protest, but the contemporaneous Citizens Channel account describes demolitions and resident resistance without identifying an assembled crowd or count. Police numbers, affected homes and household size are not protest attendance.

title.summary: Euronews retrospectively identifies Jan. 19 as the first protest; Citizens Channel documents the same-day demolition/resident-conflict episode.

start_date.summary: The official article date is Jan. 19; a Feb. 6 report calls this the first protest.

end_date.summary: No physical end is established; a Feb. 6 follow-up says residents continued protesting, and a Feb. 10 official meeting is later campaign context.

location.summary: The contemporaneous report places the demolition/resident conflict in the 5 Maji neighborhood of Tirana.

scope.summary: Local neighborhood action; later reporting describes related residents joining in other areas, but January campaign segmentation remains unresolved.

organizer.summary: Affected residents are described; no formal organizer for the Jan. 19 action is identified.

demands.summary: Residents objected to demolitions and raised concerns about information, compensation and home/property rights; category is provisional land/property policy.

participants_original.summary: Neither body reports a count of people assembled.

participants_min.summary: No numeric lower bound for assembled protesters is stated.

participants_max.summary: No crowd maximum is stated; household sizes, houses affected and police figures are different units.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: The retrospective labels Jan. 19 a protest but provides no count; the contemporaneous account does not confirm a sized public gathering.

protester_violence.summary: The report attributes force and physical/psychological violence to a resident’s account of the police operation; it does not establish protester violence.

state_response.summary: Police assisted demolitions; the report says Liza Marku was forcibly removed and her sons were taken to a station after resisting. This does not establish the formal arrest status or link the measures to a qualifying public crowd.

eligibility.summary: The date is supported, but the public-gathering occurrence/threshold for a codeable protest remains unresolved.

notes: Retain as a date-specific lead because the later Euronews account identifies Jan. 19 as the first protest. The same-day Citizens Channel article does not establish a public assembly of 50 or more and quotes one resident saying there was no need to protest that day. Do not infer turnout or assign the Feb. 10 government meeting to this gathering.
